title: App.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe an app resource.

Apple Business API 2.6+

> **Note:** When additional attributes are added by Apple, they appear automatically, without requiring a newer version of the API.

appStoreUrl.description: The App Store URL for the app.

bundleId.description: The bundle identifier of the app.

isCustomApp.description: Indicates whether this is a custom B2B app.

name.description: The display name of the app.

supportedOS.description: The list of operating systems the app supports. See [SupportedOS](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applebusinessapi/supportedos) for possible values.

version.description: The current version of the app.

websiteUrl.description: The website URL for the app.
